outline.title: Decision Infrastructure
outline.summary: A decade-stable kernel for relationship-centric decisions under uncertainty across industries.

outline.title: The same decision recurs under different names
outline.summary: Compare supplier, counterparty, contractor, and clinical-site decisions and introduce the contextual relationship decision.

outline.title: The invariant is a replayable decision event
outline.summary: State the memorable invariant and its implications for evidence, relationships, policy, action, and outcomes.

outline.title: The decision grammar is stable across industries
outline.summary: Separate universal primitives from domain-variable semantics and reject the universal risk-score abstraction.

outline.title: Financial-crime screening needs two coordinated paths
outline.summary: Explain the synchronous transaction disposition path and durable investigation and learning path.

outline.title: High-frequency screening is a temporal graph problem
outline.summary: Show why party identity, relationships, behavior, dual clocks, and distinct match states matter.

outline.title: The canonical decision object preserves the proof
outline.summary: Summarize the transaction decision object's identity, evidence, facts, policy trace, action, and replay fields.

outline.title: The Domain Adapter is the semantic boundary
outline.summary: Define what belongs in the core kernel versus the AML adapter and its responsibilities.

outline.title: The Policy Interpreter turns facts into governed action
outline.summary: Present the Policy Interpreter contract, hard constraints, unknown states, versioning, and testing.

outline.title: What must remain stable for a decade
outline.summary: List the stable theoretical and architectural invariants that future implementations must preserve.

outline.title: What should remain replaceable
outline.summary: Map pluggable surfaces—matching, policy, models, graphs, streams, simulation, and visualization—to future implementations.

outline.title: Build the kernel before the industry pack
outline.summary: Present the control-loop architecture and a staged build sequence from canonical schemas to cross-industry adapters.
